policy: Public cutoffs are selected from source availability evidence, never from odds. A public-by time is an upper bound unless a source exposes a verifiable first-public timestamp. The three legal-event cutoffs remain conservative broadcast-end anchors because the primary court records expose dates and substance but not a historical posting time.
